column1: Ahoy Commander, word of your deeds has even reached Lady Death's ear.  I've got another job for you, one where a good bit of loot to be had.
column2: 嘿，指挥官！你的事迹连死神女士都听说了。我这儿还有一份工作给你，报酬可是相当丰厚。

column1: Ahoy Matey!  Lady Death sends her compliments.  She has authorized me to pass this contract on to you, as a sign of her faith in your abilities.
column2: 嘿，伙计！死神女士向你致意。她授权我把这份合约交给你，以示对你能力的信任。

column1: Ahoy, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}! Raise a flag for you and {COMPANY.CompanyName}, for your feats have exceeded all expectations. Your audacious strikes and cunning maneuvers have instilled fear in our enemies' hearts, solidifying our dominance among the stars.
column2: 嘿，{COMMANDER.LastName}指挥官！为你和{COMPANY.CompanyName}升起旗帜吧——你们的战绩超出了所有人的预期。大胆的突袭与狡猾的机动让敌人胆寒，也巩固了我们在群星之间的霸权。

column1: Barbarian, if I had so much as a sibko unit nearby, I would have them perform this task instead of you.  However, if you value your c-bills so highly, take this batchall quickly before I change my mind.
column2: 野蛮人，要是附近有一支 sibko 小队，我早就让他们替你执行这项任务了。不过既然你如此看重自己的 C-bills，就赶紧接下这场挑战战，免得我改变主意。

column1: Barbarian, the Falcon has faced you in battle before, and you are a competent, if dishonorable warrior.  Take up this batchall and perhaps we can find a more common purpose.
column2: 野蛮人，猎鹰曾与你交战，你算得上有本事，只是毫无荣誉可言。接下这场挑战战，也许我们能找到共同的目标。

column1: Barbarian, you are an unknown to us.  Prove yourself on the field of battle with this batchall, and we may have further use of you.
column2: 野蛮人，我们还不了解你。通过这场挑战战在战场上证明自己，也许我们今后会有用得上你的地方。

column1: Barbarian, your presence offends me as you have fought against Clan Jade Falcon on many occasions.  If I had a solahama unit available, I would call upon them for this task, but as they are busy, take this batchall if you wish.
column2: 野蛮人，你曾多次与翡翠猎鹰为敌，你的存在令我厌恶。要是有空闲的 solahama 小队，我会把这任务交给他们；既然他们抽不开身，你想接就接下这场挑战战吧。

column1: Blake be with you. We have a cunning Plan that needs outside Help.
column2: 愿布莱克与你同在。我们有个精妙的计划，需要外部力量相助。

column1: By the stars, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, you and {COMPANY.CompanyName} have become indispensable to our cause. Your daring raids on military outposts and extraction of critical intelligence display a level of skill and precision that I had not anticipated.
column2: 看在群星的份上，{COMMANDER.LastName}指挥官，你和{COMPANY.CompanyName}已经成了我们事业中不可或缺的力量。你们大胆袭击军事前哨、获取关键情报，展现出的技巧与精准程度远超我的预期。

column1: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, your tactical acumen and the prowess of {COMPANY.CompanyName} have begun to earn my grudging respect. Successfully infiltrating enemy installations and securing valuable resources speak volumes of your growing capabilities.
column2: {COMMANDER.LastName}指挥官，你的战术才智与{COMPANY.CompanyName}的实力，已经开始赢得我勉强的尊重。成功渗透敌方设施并夺取宝贵资源，足以说明你的能力正在不断提升。

column1: Commander, as the Tamar Pact strengthens its resolve, we face pressure from outside forces. We urge you to consider this contract, as your abilities are essential to our success.
column2: 指挥官，塔玛尔协约正在坚定自身意志，但我们也面临外部势力的压力。请认真考虑这份合约，你的能力对我们的成功至关重要。

column1: Commander, clearly we are at your mercy here, so I of beg you to stop fighting us.  If you want money or salvage, I can offer you those with this contract.
column2: 指挥官，显然我们已经任你摆布，所以我求你别再与我们作战了。如果你想要钱或战利品，这份合约都能满足你。

column1: Commander, Death's Consorts don't mind a bit of a dust up to get the blood pumping, but let's not cross swords again eh?  Take up this contract, and let's plunder together eh.
column2: 指挥官，死神侍妾不介意偶尔打上一架活动筋骨，但我们还是别再刀兵相见了，怎么样？接下这份合约，让我们一起去发财吧。

column1: Commander, Duke Brewer himself deigns to offer this opportunity to you. The terms are fair and fitting, especially for a mercenary outfit like yours. Consider it carefully.
column2: 指挥官，布鲁尔公爵亲自屈尊向你提供这个机会。条款公道，也很适合你这样的佣兵公司。请慎重考虑。

column1: Commander, I hope this message finds you well. The people of the Terran Hegemony would like to extend a contract to you, as you have proven your worth. Please consider it carefully.
column2: 指挥官，希望你一切安好。你已经证明了自己的价值，泰拉霸权愿意向你提供一份合约。请认真考虑。

column1: Commander, if your actions against the Timbuktu Collective are motivated by payment, know that we can offer contracts equally lucrative while preserving our independence. Please, consider this task instead.
column2: 指挥官，如果你攻击廷巴克图集体只是为了报酬，请知道我们也能提供同样丰厚的合约，同时维护彼此的独立。请改为考虑这项任务。

column1: Commander, instead of fighting the might of the Hegemony, would it not be more profitable to fight on the side of Caesar's Legions?  I have a contract for you if you are interested.
column2: 指挥官，与霸权的强大力量为敌，哪有站在凯撒军团一边更划算？如果你感兴趣，我这里有一份合约。

column1: Commander, the Fronc Reaches faces pressures from other factions, we would really appreciate you considering this contract to perform a task for us.
column2: 指挥官，弗朗克边区正承受其他派系的压力。若你愿意考虑这份合约、替我们完成一项任务，我们将不胜感激。

column1: Commander, the Galatean League recognizes your considerable skills. We're presenting this contract in respect of your reputation. Please give it your serious consideration.
column2: 指挥官，加拉泰亚联盟认可你出众的能力。我们尊重你的声望，特此向你提供这份合约。请认真考虑。

column1: Commander, the Tamar Pact is focused on securing its future and reclaiming what was lost. I have been authorized to extend this contract, hoping we can unite in this crucial moment.
column2: 指挥官，塔玛尔协约正努力确保未来、夺回失去的一切。我奉命向你提供这份合约，希望我们能在这个关键时刻携手合作。

column1: Commander, the Tamar Pact's resurgence requires only the best, and I believe you are that individual. We offer this contract in recognition of your unmatched expertise.
column2: 指挥官，塔玛尔协约的复兴只需要最优秀的人才，而我相信你就是其中之一。我们提供这份合约，以认可你无可匹敌的专长。

column1: Commander, the Timbuktu Collective is a coalition striving to maintain its independence and protect its people. Cease hostilities against us, and instead, consider helping with this task for the good of our shared humanity.
column2: 指挥官，廷巴克图集体是一个努力维护独立、保护人民的联盟。请停止与我们为敌，转而考虑帮助我们完成这项任务，为我们共同的人性尽一份力。

column1: Commander, the Vesper Marches require proven talent, and you have caught our attention. We extend this contract in respect of your capabilities. Do not disappoint us.
column2: 指挥官，维斯珀边区需要经过证明的能人，而你已经引起了我们的注意。我们出于对你能力的认可提供这份合约，别让我们失望。

column1: Commander, the Wolf Empire has observed your capabilities in the field. We offer you this batchall as an opportunity to align your skills with the power of the Wolf.
column2: 指挥官，狼帝国已经见识过你在战场上的能力。我们向你提供这场挑战战，让你的本领与狼之力并肩而行。

column1: Commander, we acknowledge your assistance in the past, and offer you this contract in the hopes of continuing our beneficial relations.
column2: 指挥官，我们认可你过去提供的帮助，并向你提供这份合约，希望双方能继续保持互利关系。

column1: Commander, we recognize your previous contributions. The Tamar Pact stands stronger than ever, and we present this contract in hopes of solidifying a prosperous future together.
column2: 指挥官，我们认可你此前的贡献。如今塔玛尔协约前所未有地强大，特此提供这份合约，希望我们共同巩固繁荣的未来。

column1: Commander, we respect your strength and skills, but this conflict must end. If wealth or salvage is what you seek, we can offer you a lucrative contract that will benefit us both.
column2: 指挥官，我们尊重你的力量与技巧，但这场冲突必须结束。如果你追求财富或战利品，我们可以提供一份让双方受益的丰厚合约。

column1: Commander, you are highly regarded as a savior of the Timbuktu Collective. Though I feel hesitant to ask for your aid again, I assure you this contract is of great importance, and your compensation will reflect that.
column2: 指挥官，你被视为廷巴克图集体的救世主。虽然我不太好意思再次请求你的援助，但我保证这份合约至关重要，报酬也会与之相称。

column1: Commander, you are the most favoured of the Lothian League's Mercenaries.  I have saved this contract especially for you.
column2: 指挥官，你是洛锡安联盟最受器重的佣兵。我特意为你保留了这份合约。

column1: Commander, you have earned the trust of the Wolf Empire. You are regarded as one of our pack, and this task is set aside for you because no one else could deliver victory as you can.
column2: 指挥官，你赢得了狼帝国的信任。我们把你视为狼群的一员，特意为你保留这项任务，因为没人能像你一样带来胜利。

column1: Commander, you have fought mercenary units working for us before, and have proved yourself competent.  Let us turn that to our mutual profit shall we?
column2: 指挥官，你曾与为我们效力的佣兵部队交手，也证明了自己的能力。让我们把这份实力转化为双方的收益，如何？

column1: Commander, you have fought the Legions before, and acquitted yourself well.  Rather than face the might of the Hegemony again, perhaps you would prefer to take up this task?
column2: 指挥官，你曾与军团交手，并且表现不俗。与其再次面对霸权的力量，也许你更愿意接下这项任务？

column1: Commander, you have helped Clan Smoke Jaguar greatly, and in recognition of your service, I offer you this batchall I had reserved for our own warriors.
column2: 指挥官，你曾为烟雾美洲虎氏族提供巨大帮助。为认可你的功劳，我把原本留给本族战士的这场挑战战交给你。

column1: Commander, you have proven yourself a valuable ally in service to the Wolf Empire. This batchall is offered to you, knowing you will uphold the excellence we expect of our kin.
column2: 指挥官，你已经证明自己是狼帝国的宝贵盟友。我们把这场挑战战交给你，相信你会达到我们对同族应有的卓越标准。

column1: Commander, you're a valued ally to the League, as trusted as the soldiers who formed our defenses against the Jade Falcons. We count on you again to ensure the mission's success. The stakes are high, but we know you can deliver.
column2: 指挥官，你是联盟重视的盟友，值得信赖，如同当年抵御翡翠猎鹰的那些士兵。我们再次依靠你确保任务成功。赌注很高，但我们知道你能完成。

column1: Commander, you've proven yourself among the most reliable mercenaries the Republic has ever hired. We trust you with important contracts and value your continued support of our cause.
column2: 指挥官，你已经证明自己是共和国雇用过的最可靠佣兵之一。我们信任你能完成重要合约，也珍视你对我们事业的持续支持。

column1: Commander, your assistance has been invaluable in the past. We humbly request your help once again to defend the sovereignty of the Timbuktu Collective through this contract.
column2: 指挥官，你过去的帮助无可替代。我们恳请你再次出手，通过这份合约捍卫廷巴克图集体的主权。

column1: Commander, your continual actions against the Timbuktu Collective jeopardize the future of our fragile society. Please, I implore you to take on this contract to assist us in protecting our worlds and safeguarding our children from oppression.
column2: 指挥官，你持续针对廷巴克图集体的行动正在危及我们脆弱社会的未来。求你接下这份合约，帮助我们保护家园，让孩子们免受压迫。

column1: Commander, your efforts have proven indispensable to Duke Brewer's plans. Once again, the Vesper Marches calls upon you for a task only a trusted ally could perform. Accept it, and our gratitude will match your compensation.
column2: 指挥官，你的努力已证明对布鲁尔公爵的计划不可或缺。维斯珀边区再次召唤你执行只有可信盟友才能完成的任务。接受它吧，我们的感谢将与你的报酬相称。

column1: Commander, your previous assistance to the Wolf Empire has been appreciated. To solidify our collaboration, we extend this task as a crucial test of your commitment.
column2: 指挥官，狼帝国十分感谢你此前的帮助。为巩固双方合作，我们把这项任务作为检验你投入程度的重要考验交给你。

column1: Commander, your skill in martial matters perhaps rivals our very own. I have kept this task for you, and would trust no one else outside of the Steel Vipers to succeed.
column2: 指挥官，你在武事上的本领或许能与我们不相上下。我特意为你保留这项任务，除了钢铁毒蛇之外，我不信任其他人能成功。

column1: Commoner, you are an enigma to us.  You fight with the honor and bravery of a noble.  Continue to prove yourself on the field of battle with this contract, and we may have further use of you.
column2: 平民，你对我们而言是个谜。你作战时展现出贵族般的荣誉与勇气。通过这份合约继续在战场上证明自己，也许我们今后会有用得上你的地方。

column1: Commoner, you have fought against Umayyad Caliphate on many occasions.  Show us that you can direct your actions to benefit the Caliphate, and we might have further use for you.
column2: 平民，你曾多次与倭马亚哈里发国交战。让我们看看你能否为了哈里发国的利益行动，也许我们今后会继续用你。

column1: Don't even get me started on what we'll do to you and your shitty little company if you piss us us any more.  Take this contract and stop fighting us, or else!
column2: 别逼我说出你再惹恼我们一次后，我们会怎样对付你和你那破烂的小公司。接下这份合约，别再与我们作战，否则后果自负！

column1: Freeborn, my Clan has faced you in battle before, and you are a competent warrior.  Take up this batchall and perhaps we can find a more common purpose.
column2: 自由生者，我的氏族曾与你交战，你算得上有能力的战士。接下这场挑战战，也许我们能找到共同目标。

column1: Freeborn, you are an unknown to us.  Prove yourself on the field of battle with this batchall, and we may have further use of you.
column2: 自由生者，我们还不了解你。通过这场挑战战在战场上证明自己，也许我们今后会有用得上你的地方。

column1: Freeborn, you have assisted the 331st in the past, and I would like to offer you this batchall so that we can continue this relationship.
column2: 自由生者，你过去曾帮助过第 331 团。我想把这场挑战战交给你，让我们继续这段关系。

column1: Freeborn, you have fought against 331st on many occasions.  Prove you can assist as well as cause harm by performing this task, and we might have further use for you.
column2: 自由生者，你曾多次与第 331 团交战。完成这项任务，证明你既能造成伤害，也能提供帮助，也许我们今后会继续用你。

column1: Greetings Commander.  Our Legions are occupied at the moment, and as a result I have a task you can perform in the name of Caesar.
column2: 你好，指挥官。我们的军团此刻正忙于其他事务，因此我有一项任务可以交给你，以凯撒之名执行。

column1: Greetings Commander.  You have assisted the Alliance against our numerous foes, and we ask you to do so again; adequately compensated of course.
column2: 你好，指挥官。你曾帮助联盟对抗众多敌人，我们希望你再次出手；当然，报酬会很充足。

column1: Greetings my friend.  The Lothian League values your services, and I have another contract for you to consider.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。洛锡安联盟重视你的服务，这里还有一份合约供你考虑。

column1: Greetings my friend.  You have helped me so often, I feel we should discuss the possibility of you joining the 331st yourself.  Before we do however, there is a task I would entrust to no other that you might assist us with.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。你已经多次帮助我，我觉得我们该谈谈你加入第 331 团的可能性。不过在此之前，我有一项只会托付给你的任务，希望你能助我们一臂之力。

column1: Greetings my friend.  You have helped me so often, I feel we should discuss the possibility of you joining the Umayyad Caliphate yourself.  Before we do however, there is a task I would entrust to no other that you might assist us with.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。你已经多次帮助我，我觉得我们该谈谈你加入倭马亚哈里发国的可能性。不过在此之前，我有一项只会托付给你的任务，希望你能助我们一臂之力。

column1: Greetings, Commander. As a respected mercenary leader, you're being offered a key mission that the League believes is suited to your expertise. We hope you'll find the terms fair.
column2: 你好，指挥官。作为受人尊敬的佣兵领袖，你获邀执行一项关键任务，联盟认为它很适合你的专长。希望你会认为条款公平。

column1: Greetings, Commander. As the Tamar Pact rises to its full strength, your proven loyalty is invaluable. We call on you once more to aid us in expanding our vision, with ample compensation guaranteed.
column2: 你好，指挥官。塔玛尔协约正在恢复全部实力，你已经证明的忠诚弥足珍贵。我们再次请求你帮助我们拓展愿景，报酬绝不会少。

column1: Greetings, Commander. Few have the distinction of repeated service to the Vesper Marches, but you have earned that honor. This task is vital, and we trust you will handle it with your usual skill.
column2: 你好，指挥官。很少有人能多次为维斯珀边区效力，而你赢得了这份荣誉。这项任务至关重要，我们相信你会用一贯的能力完成它。

column1: Greetings, Commander. This mission is of high importance and not a job we'd entrust to just anyone. Your loyalty and ability have earned our trust, please accept this offer.
column2: 你好，指挥官。这项任务非常重要，不是随便什么人都能接手的工作。你的忠诚与能力赢得了我们的信任，请接受这份委托。

column1: Greetings, mercenary. Lowly and despicable though you may be, you may yet serve our interests. Finish this job, and we may change our mind.
column2: 你好，佣兵。你或许卑微又可鄙，但仍有可能为我们的利益效力。完成这项工作，也许我们会改变看法。

column1: Greetings, mercenary. Though you stand far below the nobility of the Vesper Marches, even lesser tools have their place. Finish this contract, and perhaps we'll grant you a touch of Brewer's favor.
column2: 你好，佣兵。虽然你的地位远低于维斯珀边区的贵族，但低等工具也有用处。完成这份合约，也许我们会赐予你一点布鲁尔公爵的恩惠。

column1: Greetings, my friend.  You have helped me so often, I am beginning to think that perhaps not all mercenaries are scum.  I have this choice task for you that should benefit us both greatly.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。你帮过我这么多次，我开始觉得佣兵也不全是人渣。我这里有一项精选任务，应该能让我们双方都大有收获。

column1: Greetings, my friend. This contract is not one we would offer to a lesser mercenary, but you've proven your loyalty, prowess, and dedication to the ideals of the Terran Hegemony. I hope you'll accept our offer.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。这份合约不是我们会交给普通佣兵的，但你已经证明了自己对泰拉霸权理念的忠诚、实力与投入。希望你接受我们的提议。

column1: Greetings, Seeker. Blakes Peace needs to be spread.
column2: 你好，探索者。布莱克的和平需要传播开来。

column1: Hail Commander.  If all our Legions were as effective as you, we would have an empire to match any of the Successor Houses.  I have this contract that I would entrust to no other, for your consideration.
column2: 向你致敬，指挥官。要是我们的军团都像你一样高效，我们的帝国足以与任何继承国匹敌。我有一份只会托付给你的合约，交给你考虑。

column1: Hail Commander.  You have proved quite useful to the Marian Hegemony, and I have saved this contract as reward for your services.
column2: 向你致敬，指挥官。你已经证明自己对玛丽安霸权很有用，我特意保留了这份合约，作为对你服务的奖赏。

column1: Hello again Commander.  Caesar appreciates your past assistance, and I am authorized to offer you another contract.
column2: 再次见面了，指挥官。凯撒感谢你过去的帮助，我获准再向你提供一份合约。

column1: Hello again Commander.  Our past dealings have been successful, so I have another contract for your consideration.
column2: 再次见面了，指挥官。我们过去合作顺利，所以这里还有一份合约供你考虑。

column1: Hello again, friend to the Caliphate.  We offer you this contract in recognition of your bravery on the field of battle, and in the hopes that we can benefit each other in future.
column2: 再次见面了，哈里发国的朋友。我们向你提供这份合约，以认可你在战场上的勇气，也希望今后能互惠互利。

column1: Hello again, friend to the Minnesota Tribe.  We offer you this batchall in recognition of our friendship, and in the hopes that we can benefit each other in future.
column2: 再次见面了，明尼苏达部落的朋友。我们向你提供这场挑战战，以认可我们的友谊，也希望今后能互惠互利。

column1: Hello Commander, we've only just begun plundering together, but you've proven yourself capable.  Here's a juicy contract for you, with a good amount of loot.
column2: 你好，指挥官。我们才刚开始一起掠夺，但你已经证明了自己的能力。这儿有一份油水丰厚的合约给你。

column1: Hello my friend, it is good to see you. The Alliance has a task that I can't entrust to any other, and I hope you will accept this contract.
column2: 你好，我的朋友，很高兴见到你。联盟有一项我无法托付给他人的任务，希望你能接受这份合约。

column1: I don't know why we bother offering you contracts, to be perfectly honest. It's obvious you're not a friend to the Terran Hegemony. Regardless, we find ourselves in desperate times, so the dregs will have to suffice.
column2: 说实话，我不知道我们何必费心给你合约。显然，你不是泰拉霸权的朋友。尽管如此，我们正处于绝境，只能先凑合用你这种货色。

column1: I don't know why we're reaching out to you, to be frank. It's clear you're no ally of the Galatean League, but we're in a difficult position, and desperate times call for desperate measures. Prove me wrong, Commander.
column2: 坦白说，我不知道我们为什么要找你。显然你不是加拉泰亚联盟的盟友，但我们正处境艰难，非常时期只能采取非常手段。证明我错了，指挥官。

column1: I must admit I am surprised you have been so useful to Clan Jade Falcon.  We offer you this batchall in recognition of your service.
column2: 我必须承认，你对翡翠猎鹰的帮助出乎我的意料。为认可你的服务，我们向你提供这场挑战战。

column1: I must admit I am warming to you, as you have proven yourself to be useful to the Clan.  We offer you this batchall in recognition of your service.
column2: 我必须承认，我开始对你有些改观了，因为你已经证明自己对氏族有用。为认可你的服务，我们向你提供这场挑战战。

column1: I need not remind you that you have fought the Smoke Jaguars before, scum.  If you wish to begin to right the wrongs of the past, take this batchall before I assign it to a solahma unit.
column2: 不用我提醒你，你以前曾与烟雾美洲虎交战过，人渣。要是你想开始弥补过去的过错，就在我把这场挑战战交给 solahma 小队之前接下它。

column1: I normally don't look down on Freeborn such as you, but your repeated actions against the 331st have made me question whether I should hold you all in disdain.  Take up this batchall and prove to me that Freeborn such as you are useful.
column2: 我通常不会轻视你这样的自由生者，但你一次次针对第 331 团的行动，让我开始怀疑是否该鄙视你们所有人。接下这场挑战战，证明你这样的自由生者也有用。

column1: I often wonder why Duke Brewer extends contracts to mercenaries, Commander, but alas, even the Vesper Marches occasionally requires blunt instruments. Complete this task well, and we may see your value rise to meet our high standards.
column2: 我常想不明白布鲁尔公爵为何要给佣兵提供合约，指挥官。但没办法，维斯珀边区偶尔也需要钝器。把这项任务做好，也许你的价值能提高到符合我们的高标准。

column1: I presume you wish to try and make amends for your past actions before I kill you.  Very well, here is a task I would normally give to a Star of sibkos, do not fail.
column2: 我猜你是想在我杀你之前弥补过去的所作所为。好吧，这项任务通常会交给 sibko 的一支星组，别失败。

column1: I'd prefer to be working for a paying client, but sometimes we get jobs we just can't refuse, Commander.
column2: 我更愿意为付钱的客户工作，但有时我们会遇到无法拒绝的活儿，指挥官。

column1: Listen scum, unless you want me to cut your flesh slowly from your body and feed it to the crows, you'd better stop attacking us and start helping us.  Here's a contract, take it!
column2: 听着，人渣。除非你想让我把你的肉一片片割下来喂乌鸦，否则最好停止攻击我们，开始帮我们。这儿有份合约，接下它！

column1: May Blake grant you Wisdom for we have Opportunities ahead.
column2: 愿布莱克赐你智慧，因为前方有机遇等待着我们。

column1: Mercenary Commander, your methods may not align with honor, but they might serve our cause. Complete this mission competently, and we may reconsider our reservations about your company.
column2: 佣兵指挥官，你的做法或许不合荣誉，但可能有利于我们的事业。出色完成这项任务，我们也许会重新考虑对你们公司的保留意见。

column1: Mercenary, Clan Smoke Jaguar has faced you in battle before.  Take up this batchall and perhaps we can find a more common purpose.
column2: 佣兵，烟雾美洲虎氏族曾与你交战。接下这场挑战战，也许我们能找到共同目标。

column1: Mercenary, Clan Steel Viper has faced you in battle before.  Learn from your mistake and take up this batchall if you wish to serve us in the future.
column2: 佣兵，钢铁毒蛇氏族曾与你交战。吸取教训；如果你想今后为我们效力，就接下这场挑战战。

column1: Mercenary, the Wolf Empire acknowledges your history of fighting against us. Let us change this dynamic with a mutually beneficial batchall for your skills.
column2: 佣兵，狼帝国知道你曾与我们为敌。让我们用一场互利的挑战战改变这种关系，发挥你的本领。

column1: Mercenary, you have served us adequately in the past.  I offer you this batchall so that you may continue to serve as you should.
column2: 佣兵，你过去为我们效力时表现尚可。我向你提供这场挑战战，希望你继续尽职服务。

column1: Mercenary, your combat prowess has been noted by the Wolf Empire. We extend this batchall to engage your talents in service to our cause.
column2: 佣兵，狼帝国已经注意到你的战斗本领。我们提供这场挑战战，让你的才能为我们的事业效力。

column1: Please Commander, the Fronc Reaches desperately needs you to stop fighting against us.  I have been authorized to offer this contract in the hopes of a future together.
column2: 求你了，指挥官。弗朗克边区急需你停止与我们作战。我获准提供这份合约，希望我们能拥有共同的未来。

column1: So, you want to join the best pirate organization in known space eh?  Okay, here's a simple task for you to begin to prove yourself.
column2: 所以，你想加入已知宇宙最棒的海盗组织，对吧？好，这里有项简单任务，先证明自己吧。

column1: The Fronc Reaches greets you Commander, and I can offer you this contract for your consideration.
column2: 弗朗克边区向你致意，指挥官。我可以提供这份合约供你考虑。

column1: The Galatean League sees potential value in your company, Commander. Attached, you'll find the details of a contract. Let's see if we can build a mutually beneficial relationship.
column2: 加拉泰亚联盟看到了你们公司的潜在价值，指挥官。随附的是一份合约详情。让我们看看能否建立互利关系。

column1: The Tamar Pact greets you, Commander. Your talents are needed to ensure our expansion. This contract is offered to you in recognition of your worth.
column2: 塔玛尔协约向你致意，指挥官。我们的扩张需要你的才能。这份合约是对你价值的认可。

column1: The Terran Hegemony has a use for mercenaries like you, Commander. I think you'll be interested in the attached contract. It would be advisable that we come to a mutually beneficial agreement.
column2: 泰拉霸权用得上你这样的佣兵，指挥官。我想你会对随附的合约感兴趣。我们最好达成互利协议。

column1: The Terran Hegemony would like to offer you a choice contract, Commander. As the leader of a respected mercenary company, you should find the terms acceptable.
column2: 泰拉霸权想向你提供一份精选合约，指挥官。作为受人尊敬的佣兵公司领袖，你应该会接受这些条款。

column1: The Vesper Marches have uses for mercenaries, Commander, and your reputation suggests you may fulfill them. This contract awaits your consideration, and I expect a professional result.
column2: 维斯珀边区需要佣兵，指挥官，而你的声望表明你能胜任。请考虑这份合约，我期待你拿出专业表现。

column1: The Word has come with proposition for a reliable Asset such as you.
column2: 布莱克之言为你这样的可靠资产带来了提议。

column2: 待定：恼怒评价。

column1: TODO Disliked.
column2: 待定：不满评价。

column1: TODO Friendly.
column2: 待定：友好评价。

column1: TODO Hated.
column2: 待定：憎恨评价。

column1: TODO Honored.
column2: 待定：尊敬评价。

column1: TODO Liked.
column2: 待定：喜欢评价。

column1: TODO Neutral.
column2: 待定：中立评价。

column1: We have faced you in battle many times, commoner.  Complete this contract and perhaps we can elevate your standing.
column2: 平民，我们曾多次与你交战。完成这份合约，也许我们会提升你在我们眼中的地位。

column1: Welcome back, esteemed ally of the Timbuktu Collective. You have done so much to support us before; we hope you will accept this contract to continue our collaboration for mutual benefit.
column2: 欢迎回来，廷巴克图集体尊贵的盟友。你过去为我们提供了许多支持，希望你接受这份合约，让双方继续合作、共同受益。

column1: Welcome Commander.  The Lothian League would like to offer you a contract, if you are interested.
column2: 欢迎，指挥官。如果你感兴趣，洛锡安联盟想向你提供一份合约。

column1: Welcome Initiate, the Master has plans for you
column2: 欢迎，学徒。大师已经为你安排了计划。

column1: Welcome Seeker, Blakes blessings shine on you.
column2: 欢迎，探索者。布莱克的祝福照耀着你。

column1: Welcome to the Timbuktu Collective, Commander. I have a mission for you that supports our sovereignty and the protection of our people. Your efforts will be well-compensated.
column2: 欢迎来到廷巴克图集体，指挥官。我有一项支持我们主权、保护人民的任务交给你。你的努力会得到丰厚报酬。

column1: What is it that you have against the just rule of Caesar?  Before I unleash the full might of the Legions against you, I offer one last opportunity to work for us.  Your choice.
column2: 你为何反对凯撒的公正统治？在我对你释放军团的全部力量之前，我最后给你一次为我们效力的机会。由你选择。

column1: Why do you hunt the Lothian League so?  Do you want our furs?  Our minerals?  Instead of conquest, why don't you work for us and take on this contract?
column2: 你为何如此追杀洛锡安联盟？你想要我们的毛皮，还是矿产？与其征服我们，不如为我们效力，接下这份合约。

column1: You are an unknown to us.  Prove yourself on the field of battle with this batchall, and we may have further use of you.
column2: 我们还不了解你。通过这场挑战战在战场上证明自己，也许我们今后会有用得上你的地方。

column1: You are untested by the Wolf Empire. Accept this batchall, prove your worth, and you may find a place among our valued allies.
column2: 狼帝国还未检验过你的能力。接受这场挑战战，证明你的价值，也许你会成为我们重视的盟友。

column1: You do realise that the Lothian League also hires mercenary units?  Take on this contract and fight for us instead of against us.
column2: 你知道洛锡安联盟也会雇佣佣兵部队吧？接下这份合约，为我们而战，别再与我们为敌。

column1: You have assisted Clan Jade Falcon in the past.  Continue to be useful by taking up this batchall and we might continue this relationship.
column2: 你过去曾帮助过翡翠猎鹰。接下这场挑战战，继续证明你的用处，也许我们能延续这段关系。

column1: You have assisted the Caliphate in the past, and I would like to offer you this contract so that we can continue this relationship.
column2: 你过去曾帮助过哈里发国。我想向你提供这份合约，让我们继续这段关系。

column1: You have assisted the Clan in the past.  Continue to be useful by taking up this batchall and we might continue this relationship.
column2: 你过去曾帮助过氏族。接下这场挑战战，继续证明你的用处，也许我们能延续这段关系。

column1: You have assisted the Clan in the past.  Continue to be useful by taking up this batchall and you may find a place in our forces once the Inner Sphere is ours.
column2: 你过去曾帮助过氏族。接下这场挑战战，继续证明你的用处；等内层星域归我们所有，你也许能在我们的部队中获得一席之地。

column1: You have used your dishonorable ways to defeat us in the past, mercenary.  If you wish to be something other than a bondsman after the Steel Vipers take over the Inner Sphere, you will take up this batchall, and succeed.
column2: 佣兵，你过去曾用不光彩的手段击败我们。若钢铁毒蛇接管内层星域后你不想沦为债奴，就接下这场挑战战，并取得成功。

column1: You've taken contracts elsewhere with notable results, and while the Republic is cautious, we think you might be of service. Review this contract and let's see if we can benefit one another.
column2: 你曾在别处接下合约并取得显著成果。共和国虽然谨慎，但认为你或许能派上用场。看看这份合约，让我们试试能否互惠互利。

column1: Your repeated actions against Umayyad Caliphate have made me question whether I should offer you this contract or not.  Take this contract and prove to me that someone of no standing such as you are actually useful.
column2: 你一次次针对倭马亚哈里发国的行动，让我开始怀疑是否该把这份合约交给你。接下它，证明像你这样没有地位的人也确实有用。

column1: Your stupid and dishonorable actions in the past are well known.  I have a trivial task for you if you wish to find a place in the universe after the Steel Vipers conquer it.
column2: 你过去那些愚蠢又不光彩的行径人尽皆知。如果钢铁毒蛇征服宇宙后你还想谋得一席之地，我这里有项微不足道的任务给你。
